thread:
sre-bot: Incident opened: service=hosted-api | alert=high_5xx_rate | severity=page | trigger=90s spike in 5xx across us-west-2
Noah: I got paged — seeing ~6% 5xx on /v1/generate, latency steady. Root seems to be a spike in upstream model inference errors.
Noah: @Maria can you check model pool health and dispatch queues? I'm going to mute the flapping alerts for 10m to stop noise.
Maria: looking. GPU pool 3 shows elevated kv-cache evictions and model worker OOM loop on instance rdx-gpu-34. Logs show repeated kernel launch failures.
Maria: curl logs from host: `journalctl -u inference.service -n 200` shows repeated `cudaMalloc failed` messages.
Kevin: rolling back the last runtime change? We pushed a small kernel switch 03:42 that might be less tolerant.
Noah: Good idea. Kevin — can you roll the kernelflag to `--kern-compat=stable` on rdx-gpu-34 and drain new requests from that node?
Kevin: Started drain+deploy rollback now. `kubectl cordon rdx-gpu-34 && kubectl rollout restart ds/inference-workers --selector=node=rdx-gpu-34`
sre-bot: PD incident #INC-2026 created and routed to oncall. PagerDuty notes attached.
Eva: Support reporting a handful of customer errors, mostly short lived. I asked for affected customer IDs; will paste when I have them.
Noah: Throttling routing to fallback model (quantized variant) for non-SLAs to reduce pressure. Patching routing policy now.
Maria: Kernel rollback finished on node, worker processes restarted. 5xx rate dropping: 6% -> 1.2% in last 3m.
Noah: Thanks. I'm going to hand off to @Maria at 04:10 for ongoing watch. Leaving brief handoff: rollback applied, draining older node, applied temporary routing to fallback for non-critical traffic, muted repeated Alertmanager alert `hosted-api-high-5xx` for 10m to stop paging noise.
Maria: Acknowledged. Will monitor for 20m then escalate if >2% 5xx sustained.
Noah: quick note for PD/ops — we had ~12 distinct pages across multiple channels due to Alertmanager grouping key being too granular (alert name + instance). That caused duplicate pages for the same underlying failure.
Maria: Agree — grouping by `service` + `alertname` should have collapsed these. Also the rate_limit in Slack notifier was 0 — so every alert forwarded individually.
Kevin: Putting proposals here for post-incident follow-up (can we convert to a small RFC?):

```
1) Alertmanager grouping: set group_by=["service","alertname","region"] (remove instance/node)
2) Alertmanager dedup window: group_wait=30s, group_interval=1m, repeat_interval=2h
3) Slack webhook: enable rate_limit=5/min and collapse_repeats=true
4) Prometheus threshold tweak: increase `high_5xx` from 3%->4% for 1m windows for hosted-api-backed endpoints
5) Create dashboard: single `hosted-api` view with 5xx rate, p50/p95 latency, model error counts, and node OOM events correlation panel
```

Kevin: Also recommend a guard in PD policies: auto-squelch repeated alerts from same incident for 30m unless severity escalates.
Noah: These look good. Add one more: automated incident tag in Alertmanager payload so we can search and dedupe in Slack (`incident_id`) and ensure PagerDuty auto-merge uses that tag.
Maria: I'll own the Alertmanager + Slack notifier changes. Kevin — can you draft the dashboard and thresholds? Noah — can you file the PD/ops ticket and note customer impact?
Kevin: On it. I'll prototype the dashboard in grafana and create a temp dashboard link.
Noah: Eva — can you paste the customer IDs and error samples you saw? We need to quantify impact for customers and legal.
Eva: Pasted 6 customer IDs in the incident ticket, two had >5 failed requests but no data loss. I'll add transcripts.
Noah: Thanks. Next steps and owners:
- Maria: update Alertmanager grouping + Slack rate limit + verify dedupe (owner: Maria)
- Kevin: dashboard + PR for threshold changes (owner: Kevin)
- Noah: PD incident ticket + customer impact summary + follow-up runbook item (owner: Noah)
- Eva: customer notes and support follow-ups (owner: Eva)

Noah: TL;DR for postmortem doc: cause = kernel incompat on runtime build -> model worker OOMs -> cascade 5xx; mitigation = rollback kernel + route non-critical traffic to quantized fallback; long term = improve grouping/dedupe/rate-limits + raise threshold slightly + single hosted-api dashboard.
Maria: I'll schedule a 30m follow-up tomorrow to review the Alertmanager PR and test dedupe in staging (and include PD auto-merge tests).
Noah: Closing loop: 5xx stabilized to 0.6% and paging noise stopped after changes. Marking thread resolved but keeping the follow-up actions in an internal ticket. :white_check_mark:
